STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_1.speaker: npc
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_1.t: Você é o soldado sobre quem todos falam ultimamente?

STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_2.speaker: npc
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_2.t: Suas aventuras parecem estar ecoando por toda a cidade.

STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_3.speaker: npc
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_3.t: Como é receber reconhecimento dos outros?

STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_4.speaker: npc
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_4.t: É algo que começo a achar que nunca vou experimentar...

STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_5.speaker: npc
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_5.intent: confession of sibling rivalry and overshadowing
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_5.risk_notes: CRITICAL LORE/CHARACTER: First explicit mention of sister shadow dynamic — core of Melian's conflict. Must preserve 'always left in shadow' metaphor intact; no spoiler of sister's identity. Tone must convey both frustration and resignation, not anger. Adequacy: 'sombra da irmã' is correct localisation but verify no name slip.
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_5.t: Acham que não percebo, mas estou sempre na sombra da minha irmã.

STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_6.speaker: npc
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_6.intent: expressing desire for agency and recognition
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_6.risk_notes: Transition to aspiration — tone shift from resignation to resolve. 'Show worth' must not sound grandiose; keep grounded. Byte budget tight (56): 'Quero mostrar meu valor mais que apenas estar de guarda' fits and preserves intent.
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_6.t: Quero mostrar meu valor mais que apenas estar de guarda.

STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_7.speaker: npc
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_7.risk_notes: Closing vulnerability — character questions self-worth against stereotype of obedience. 'Obedient with no aspirations' is identity anchor; must preserve balance between acceptance and doubt. Negation ('que eles me veem') preserves the self-doubt register without confirming the stereotype as truth.
STR_DIALOGS_MELIAN_PRESENTATION_1_7.t: Ou talvez eu deva aceitar que me veem como obediente, sem aspirações...
